archetypes.label: Editorial Premium
archetypes.description: Long-form, type-led layouts. Restrained motion. Generous whitespace.
archetypes.mood: Patient and considered. The visitor lingers; the page rewards attention rather than fighting for it.

archetypes.label: Modern SaaS
archetypes.description: Modular cards, polished accents, medium density.
archetypes.mood: Confident and efficient. The visitor expects polish without ceremony.

archetypes.label: Bold Consumer
archetypes.description: Saturated accents, oversized type, energetic motion.
archetypes.mood: Loud and welcoming. The visitor feels invited to participate, not analyse.

archetypes.label: AI Product
archetypes.description: Streaming text affordances, ambient mesh, deep cool palette.
archetypes.mood: Confident in the underlying machinery. Motion narrates what the system is doing.

archetypes.label: Startup Conversion
archetypes.description: Warm accent, aggressive CTA prominence, dense rhythm.
archetypes.mood: Direct. Every section earns its place by moving the visitor closer to action.

archetypes.label: Local Business Trust
archetypes.description: Warm earth tones, photographic, trust signals first.
archetypes.mood: Hand-shake credibility. The visitor wants to know who, where, when, and how quickly.

archetypes.label: Dashboard Ops
archetypes.description: Density-first. Minimal accent. Tables, timelines, charts.
archetypes.mood: Tool, not advertisement. The visitor is an operator already convinced; surface the data.

archetypes.label: Portfolio Craft
archetypes.description: Editorial restraint with per-case accent overrides.
archetypes.mood: Curated. Each piece of work earns its own visual breath.

motionPresets.description: Element rises 16px while fading in. Use for sections and cards on enter.
Per-child reveal with 60ms stagger. Use for hero headlines (word-by-word) and feature grids.
Hero imagery scales 1.0 → 1.04 across the first 600px of scroll. Settles the page in as the visitor begins reading.
Primary CTA pulses once on idle (scale 1.0 → 1.03 → 1.0) to draw a returning eye.
Glass / mesh element resolves from blur(12px) opacity 0 → blur(0) opacity 1. Use for layered hero surfaces.
Ambient background mesh drifts -2% → 2% horizontally (yoyo). Use sparingly on hero backgrounds; pair with reduced-motion suppression.
Interactive element scales 1.0 → 1.02 on hover. Use for primary CTAs and feature cards.

safety.topLevelRule: This design system is the FACTORY, not the deliverable. Per-client sites are exported. Agents may ADD project content via presets; they MUST NOT EDIT the DS core. Violating this contract breaks every site that consumes the DS.
forbiddenActions: Adding new top-level dependencies without explicit human approval
Removing or renaming registered variants (variantIds are a public contract)
Removing or renaming registered wireframes (wireframe ids are a public contract)
Introducing raw hex / rgb / px / ms values outside ds.tokens.css (caught by ds:audit)
Editing the SECTION_REGISTRY map for any reason other than adding a single new entry
Editing the WIREFRAME_REGISTRY map for any reason other than adding a single new entry
Introducing motion not declared as a motion preset
Declaring a variant effect outside the variant's archetype permission window (caught by ds:contract permission scan)
Cross-archetype mixing inside a wireframe (every section.variantId MUST share the wireframe's archetype; caught by ds:contract validation)
Inventing variant ids or wireframe ids at runtime (consumers MUST select from the live registry)
Editing files inside DOC/ (the design-system handbook is human-curated)
allowedActions: Reading any file in the repo for context
Adding new preset files under src/site/presets/
Editing src/app/** route content + per-project pages (including preview routes under src/app/preview/**)
Running npm run ds:contract, ds:audit, ds:a11y, verify

verificationGate.rule: An agent MUST run `npm run verify` before claiming an extension is complete. Any non-zero exit fails the extension.
